instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_036_mold_split_simple.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, a drafted plastic housing from Z=0 to Z=40. Its bottom and top sections are 80 x 50 mm, and its maximum section at Z=20 is 100 x 70 mm. Split the part at the Z=20 mm parting plane into core_side for the lower half and cavity_side for the upper half. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_036_core_side.step and C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_036_cavity_side.step. The two solids must not overlap, their split faces must lie on Z=20, and their Boolean union must equal the original geometry. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut).
